relationships.subject: VX-548
relationships.evidence_quote: the novel NaV1.8 channel inhibitor, VX-548 has surpassed previously studied NaV1.8 inhibitors in clinical trials

key_findings: Review: VX-548, a Nav1.8 inhibitor, outperformed earlier Nav1.8 inhibitors in clinical trials for postsurgical pain.
Nav1.8 (SCN10A) is minimally expressed in the brain, suggesting lower CNS adverse effects.
